core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Cinema Noir with Cyberpunk UI
Content is King: The movie art is the hero; UI recedes
Negative Space: Massive breathing room between sections
Contrast: Glowing accents against deep void backgrounds

rules: Use 'Bebas Neue' for ranking numbers (1, 2, 3...) or 'COMING SOON' tags.
Headings must have tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.05em).

usage.card: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/5 hover:border-white/10 transition-colors duration-300

buttons.default: h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-medium transition-all duration-300 active:scale-95

cards.movie_poster: relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl aspect-[2/3] group cursor-pointer transition-transform duration-500 hover:scale-105 hover:z-10
cards.glass_panel: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-8

navigation.wrapper: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 transition-all duration-300

grid_system.bento_movies: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 md:gap-8 auto-rows-[300px]
grid_system.hero_section: relative h-[85vh] w-full flex items-end pb-24
grid_system.carousel: flex gap-6 overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory scrollbar-hide pb-12

textures.noise: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit' or 'Syne'.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000) for backgrounds. Use #050505 or #0A0A0A.
Do NOT use default shadcn cards. Remove background, add subtle border.
Do NOT center text by default. Use left align for cinematographic feel.
Ensure 3:1 contrast for large text and 4.5:1 for body text.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Update 'tailwind.config.js' with the new color palette (obsidian, void, electric indigo).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Create a 'Layout' component that handles the Navbar (glassmorphism) and Footer.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Build the 'MovieCard' component: Aspect Ratio 2/3, hidden overflow, image zoom on hover.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Build the 'HeroSection': Full height, background video/image with bottom fade, title bottom-left aligned.
